protocol.fixed_entry_control: Original trainedTCN32 24h/g1 EV>0 after next-open quote repricing; original probabilities NEVER attributed to new barriers/unlimited holding.
protocol.primary_coverage_selection: Longest common gap-free M1 interval across4assets, chosen BEFORE outcomes using timestamps only.
protocol.test_status: Retrospective exploratory historical strategy comparison; no untouched independent-holdout claim.
protocol.exit_policy: TP/SL only. No timeout or data-end sales. Open positions separately marked net of hypothetical liquidation costs; not wins/losses.
protocol.selection: VAL>=5 closed trades, positive endmarkednetreturn at0bp and15bp, maximize return%-0.5*minuteDD%; stable declared grid tie. Otherwise exploratory.
protocol.anchor: Actual next-minute nativeOPEN reference, before assumed entry slippage. Gross targets fixed across costs; netR targets incorporate each scenario costs.
protocol.breakeven: Gross exactmultiplicative fees+slippage; netR p=1/(1+R). If nettargetreward<=0, breakeven winrate is unachievable.
